title: Prepare owner-reviewed development activation
description: The current common prompt authorizes smoke checks only; self-claim is disabled and all specialists are offline. Prepare a scoped development plan, workload/model budget, approved work selection, landing/recoverability boundary and worktree convergence preview. Do not change authorization or start a provider based on this task alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can review scope and budget before activation
Smoke-only instructions and existing work remain unchanged until separate approval
Manager triage distinguishes proposed work from ready assignments
